# Owl Protocol

Owl Protocol empowers developers to build feature-rich, user-friendly Web3 applications for mainstream adoption through modular infrastructure that simplifies blockchain development.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/owl-protocol/.

## Actions

- **Deploy ERC721 Collection**: Deploy a new erc721 collection contract.
- **Get Project Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific project.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List all projects.
